note: Known sermon series. The YouTube sync uses this to sort messages into series and to strip boilerplate out of titles, because the video titles spell things inconsistently. Add a new series when one starts.

howto.name: The series name as it should read on the website.
howto.subtitle: The long strap-line the church repeats in every video title for this series. It is stripped out so the sermon's own title is what shows.
howto.aliases: Any misspelling or variant that has gone out on YouTube.

series.name: Deep Waters
series.subtitle: Exploring the Depths of Spiritual Growth

series.name: Follow Me

notSermonsNote: Video titles matching any of these (case-insensitive) are not treated as sermons and never reach the website. The sync prints what it skipped so the list can be corrected.
